description.narrative: Nicaragua - PROPERTY REGULARIZATION PROJECT - Cadastral Mapping Activity: Conduct area-wide cadastral mapping in Leon to obtain current property descriptions to be recorded in a geographic information system. To provide an accurate and current physical description of all property in Leon, MCC Funding will be used to: (i) Clarify municipal and urban administrative boundaries; (ii) Prepare base maps on which parcel boundaries will be demarcated; (iii) Perform parcel-by-parcel demarcation and mapping; and (iv) Publish mapping results to enable owners and occupants to review demarcated parcel boundaries and request clarification and/or corrections, if needed.
